headline: Enhance ClearInstall Security and Transparency
summary: By integrating public trend signals, ClearInstall can improve its security features and user transparency. This will help in identifying potential risks early during the installation process.
actions: Integrate real-time vulnerability checks for npm/PyPI packages to provide up-to-date security information.
Add support for analyzing `binding.gyp` files more comprehensively, ensuring all dependencies are securely evaluated.
Implement a feature that scans for known malicious patterns in package metadata and dependency trees.
